prompt: Create an original 150 second melodic chiptune instrumental composition for nature documentary, landscape and gentle exploration. Mood: organic, open, fresh. Instruments: pulse-wave lead, triangle bass, noise percussion. Style: clear arpeggiated game-like melody and concise rhythmic phrases. Tempo approximately 132 BPM; D dorian. Main idea: an ascending fourth answered by a stepwise descent. Introduce a gently rising motif and a sense of open air. Instrumental only. No vocals, no choir, no humming, no singing, no speech, no lyrics, no vocal samples. Do not imitate any existing artist or melody. [00:00-00:50] Establish the main idea immediately with the core ensemble. [00:50-01:40] Develop the motif with a complementary instrumental counterline, preserving the intended energy. [01:40-02:30] Return to the main idea and give a musically resolved ending with a short natural tail. Finish around 02:30.

description.en: An energetic and adventurous electronic track featuring prominent synth melodies, driving electronic drums, and a dynamic arrangement that shifts from playful to epic. It has a retro-futuristic feel.
description.zh: 一首充满活力和冒险精神的电子音乐，以突出的合成器旋律、强劲的电子鼓点和从活泼到史诗般的动态编排为特色。它带有一种复古未来主义的感觉。
